translations.zh: 赛博朋克侦探电影场景，透过带雨水的车窗观察。霓虹倒影在玻璃上映照，英俊的未来侦探身穿厚重深色大衣坐在驾驶座。身穿发光半透明黄色夹克的女子看着他，背景是雾气缭绕的未来都市与飞行载具。
translations.en: A cinematic cyberpunk scene viewed through a rain-soaked car window with neon reflections, featuring a futuristic detective in a dark coat and a woman in a glowing yellow jacket inside a vehicle, against a foggy sci-fi cityscape with flying cars.
